trust_boundary_disclosure: The empirical classification of raw BatteryML evidence and CSV recalculations are performed by the external domain adapter. The Lean-verified S2 core formally governs only the deterministic precedence traversal and terminal adjudication of the resulting normalized DecisionView.

epistemic_disposition.relationship_to_target_native_adjudicati: The target study's native adjudication logic (s3_adjudication.py) yields MODEL_SPECIFIC under two-sided relative error shift (|D| >= 0.10, where only Ridge exceeds 0.50). The P10 retrospective claim C_P10_RETRO asserts a strictly conjunctive robustness requirement across all candidate architectures. Under C_P10_RETRO, Ridge's positive degradation rate of 85.94% (55/64) violates the conjunction, producing NotVerified. The two outcomes answer distinct formal claims over the identical cryptographically bound dataset.
epistemic_disposition.strict_non_softening_enforcement: Enforced. Although hasNonBlockingLimitation was derived as true (due to L_CHEMISTRY_LFP), S2 Step 2 immediately issued NotVerified upon encountering O_STATISTICAL_PREVALENCE = violated, completely bypassing limitation evaluation at Step 6.
